Levels: ground, boulders and growth for all twelve biomes v1.2-level

The real flight renderer, paused, in real flight lighting only: the wisp's own light at two places along each course, then a Flash pickup moment. Left: before, the game with the ground dressing off (?scenery=1: the original terrain material and the shared ecology plants). Right: after, what the game ships now: each biome's own top lip, strata and half-buried boulders inside the ground, and surface growth that fits the place. Background, edge light, collision, courses, hazards and pickups are the same in both columns. Each biome has its own code (v1.2-level-<biome>) for approval.
